summary: Tested the home hero button fix (#btn-inscreva-se-topo) and the bottom CTA (#btn-inscreva-se) on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844) with Playwright, using real mouse moves. The top button now stays visible on hover: computed bg is rgb(8,137,191) (#0889bf), text and border are white, opacity 1, visibility visible, size 305x56. Hovering 3 times in a row gave the same result. Clicking shows the 'Carregando...' loader, then goes to /termos.html. Bottom button: on hover it switches to the theme's outline style (transparent bg, cyan text #069edb, cyan border). It is still visible on the light gray section, and clicking goes to /termos.html. Mobile: tapping the top button goes to /termos.html.
critical_code_review_comments: The original cause was the theme rule '.btn-accent:not(.btn-hover-nobg):not(.icon-animated):hover{background-color:transparent!important}' plus 'color:#069edb!important'. Together they made the button cyan on a cyan hero, so it looked like it disappeared. The ID-scoped override in build_cesgranrio.py (html body #btn-inscreva-se-topo:hover{background:#0889bf!important;color:#fff!important...}) wins on specificity and fixes it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page is a static file, /app/frontend/public/inicio.html, generated by /app/memory/home_build/build_cesgranrio.py. Don't use networkidle for page waits: it never settles. Use domcontentloaded plus a timeout.
